name: k3y69b-haiku-connectors
goal: Haiku module workers no longer receive claude.ai connector tools mid-session, so fresh sessions stop hitting the context limit at startup

evidence: Count-only live probes: without --strict-mcp-config the second request adds a role:system message with text+tool_addition blocks (about 56.6k o200k tokens, 93 mcp names); the tools array stays at 7. With the flag that message never appears. Expected: a module worker receives no connector tools.

The CLI relay tests sent short synthetic histories, no test pinned the module worker's MCP isolation, and a single-turn CLI probe ends before connectors load. module-worker-mcp.test.ts now pins the worker command.
